about: The café's avatar skeleton: character-independent joint names. A character supplies where they sit in its art (parts.json per view); animations move them. Bones use a 2D projected pseudo-3D swing model (see rig.py).

front.note: facing you, walking down-right (SE); SW is this mirrored

back.note: facing away, walking up-right (NE); NW is this mirrored

south.note: facing you square on, walking straight down the screen (S)

north.note: facing away square on, walking straight up the screen (N)

east.note: side on, walking straight right across the screen (E); W is this mirrored

legs.near: the leg nearest the camera in a drawn view
legs.note: In both drawn views (front = SE, back = NE) the near leg is the character's right leg, so an animation that times the legs by body side stays in step when someone turns. The mirrored views (SW, NW) swap sides, as a mirror does.
